en: A black and white night-time photograph showing two steam locomotives at a train yard. The locomotives are illuminated by their own headlights and nearby street lamps, creating dramatic beams of light in the night. Visible on the right locomotive is the number '23 1113,' which can give clues to its origin. There are train tracks and some blurred infrastructure visible in the background.
